items.source: In case of an array, Collection, or Map dependency type, the container autowires all beans matching the declared value type. For such purposes, the map keys must be declared as type String which will be resolved to the corresponding bean names. Such a container-provided collection will be ordered, taking into account Ordered and @Order values of the target components, otherwise following their registration order in the container. Alternatively, a single matching target bean may also be a generally typed Collection or Map itself, getting injected as such.
items.translation: 对于数组、`Collection` 或 `Map` 依赖类型，容器会自动注入所有匹配声明类型的 Bean。为此，Map 的键必须声明为 `String` 类型，该类型将被解析为相应的 Bean 名称。此类由容器提供的集合将按顺序排列，同时考虑目标组件的 `Ordered` 和 `@Order` 值；否则，将遵循它们在容器中的注册顺序。或者，单个匹配的目标 Bean 本身也可以是一个通用类型的 `Collection` 或 `Map`，并以此形式被注入。

items.source: Note that actual injection is performed through a BeanPostProcessor which in turn means that you cannot use @Autowired to inject references into BeanPostProcessor or BeanFactoryPostProcessor types. Please consult the javadoc for the AutowiredAnnotationBeanPostProcessor class (which, by default, checks for the presence of this annotation).
items.translation: 请注意，实际的注入是通过一个 `BeanPostProcessor` 接口执行的，这意味着您 不能 使用 `@Autowired` 将引用注入到 `BeanPostProcessor` 或 `BeanFactoryPostProcessor` 类型的对象中。请查阅 `AutowiredAnnotationBeanPostProcessor` 类的 javadoc（该处理器默认会检查此注解是否存在）。

items.source: Only one constructor of any given bean class may declare this annotation with the required() attribute set to true, indicating the constructor to be autowired when used as a Spring bean. Furthermore, if the required attribute is set to true, only a single constructor may be annotated with @Autowired. If multiple non-required constructors declare the annotation, they will be considered as candidates for autowiring. The constructor with the greatest number of dependencies that can be satisfied by matching beans in the Spring container will be chosen. If none of the candidates can be satisfied, then a primary/default constructor (if present) will be used. Similarly, if a class declares multiple constructors but none of them is annotated with @Autowired, then a primary/default constructor (if present) will be used. If a class only declares a single constructor to begin with, it will always be used, even if not annotated. An annotated constructor does not have to be public.
items.translation: 任何给定的 Bean 类中，最多只能有一个构造函数声明此注解并将 required() 属性设置为 true，以指示在作为 Spring Bean 使用时进行自动装配的该构造函数。此外，如果 required 属性设置为 true，则只能有一个构造函数被标注为 @Autowired。如果有多个非必需的构造函数声明了此注解，它们将被视为自动装配的候选项。将选择依赖项数量最多且能够通过匹配 Spring 容器中的 Bean 来满足的构造函数。如果没有任何候选项可以满足，则将使用主/默认构造函数（如果存在）。同样，如果一个类声明了多个构造函数但均未标注 @Autowired，则将使用主/默认构造函数（如果存在）。如果一个类最初只声明了一个构造函数，即使未加注解，也将始终使用该构造函数。已标注的构造函数不必是 public 的。

items.source: In the case of a multi-arg constructor or method, the required() attribute is applicable to all arguments. Individual parameters may be declared as Java-8 style Optional as well as @Nullable or a not-null parameter type in Kotlin, overriding the base 'required' semantics.
items.translation: 对于多参数构造函数或方法，required() 属性适用于所有参数。可以单独将参数声明为 Java-8 风格的Optional以及 Kotlin 中的@Nullable或不可空参数类型，从而覆盖基础的“必需”语义。

items.source: Although @Autowired can technically be declared on individual method or constructor parameters, most parts of the framework ignore such declarations. The only part of the core Spring Framework that actively supports autowired parameters is the JUnit Jupiter support in the spring-test module (see the TestContext framework reference documentation for details).
items.translation: 尽管 `@Autowired` 在技术上可以声明在单个方法或构造函数参数上，但框架的大部分组件会忽略此类声明。核心 Spring Framework 中唯一主动支持自动注入参数的部分是 `spring-test` 模块中的 JUnit Jupiter 支持（有关详细信息，请参阅 TestContext 框架 参考文档）。

items.source:
Fields are injected right after construction of a bean, before any config methods
are invoked. Such a config field does not have to be public.
items.translation: 字段在 Bean 构建之后、任何配置方法调用之前注入。此类配置字段不必是公开的。

items.source:
Config methods may have an arbitrary name and any number of arguments; each of
those arguments will be autowired with a matching bean in the Spring container.
Bean property setter methods are effectively just a special case of such a general
config method. Such config methods do not have to be public.
items.translation: 配置方法可以具有任意名称和任意数量的参数；这些参数中的每一个都将通过 Spring 容器自动注入匹配的 Bean。Bean 属性 setter 方法实际上只是此类通用配置方法的特例。此类配置方法不必是公开的。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Mark Fisher, Sam Brannen

items.source: Declares whether the annotated dependency is required.
items.translation: 声明已标注的依赖项是否为必需项。
